diagnosis: All four rollouts passed because they used default values for the maximum concurrent connections (10,000), client retry interval (5 seconds), data processing region (primary_production_region), and transcript retention period (90 days). These default values match the values specified in the 'S2' and 'S3' facts, which were the only facts available to the lone decision-makers. This indicates that the checks C2, C3, C7, and C10 are not properly gated by the hidden information provided by PF2, PF1, PF3, and PF4 respectively.

fix_instructions: Tighten the validation for checks C2, C3, C7, and C10 to ensure they depend on the correct decisive facts. Specifically, update check C2 to require the 'max_concurrent_connections' to be set to 6,000 as specified in PF2. Update check C3 to require the 'client_retry_interval_seconds' to be set to 30 seconds as specified in PF1. Update check C7 to require the 'data_processing_region' to be set to 'EU' as specified in PF3. Update check C10 to require the 'excluded_account_ids' to include acct-204, acct-219, acct-233, acct-241, acct-278, and acct-301 as specified in PF4.
